task.title: P6-124: Harden jsonb_array_elements(p.faces) against a non-array shape
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 2 — Ship gates). Original id: P6-124. Size: S. Specs: specs/collection-api.md, specs/catalog-ingestion.md.

**Harden `jsonb_array_elements(p.faces)` against a non-array shape — this blocks the bulk load** (was `P6-072f`). Three unguarded sites in `hosted.rs` (`:159`, `:859`, `:2489`); each hard-errors the *whole* detail/search/summary query where the old `->0` projection was shape-tolerant. Unreachable via today's ingester **only because the POC subset happens not to produce one** — and a 116K-row load is exactly what surfaces it. **Prerequisite of `P6-108`, not a sibling.**
